resources.string: Verified business. Tap to see how it was verified.
Android asks you to choose a caller ID & spam app. With it, OpenCaller can show who is calling and stop spam before your phone rings. It works with your current phone app.
OpenCaller never blocks your outgoing calls or emergency numbers. If something goes wrong while checking a call, the call rings as usual.
Use your own names for your contacts
When someone in your contacts calls, OpenCaller shows the name you saved and never marks them as spam.
Your contacts stay on this phone. OpenCaller never uploads, shares or sells them.
OpenCaller uses notifications for the summary after a call, blocked-call alerts and caller ID when it can\'t show over other apps.
No ads, no promotions. Without notifications, summaries stay in your call history in the app.
As your phone app, OpenCaller shows caller ID right on the call screen and keeps your call history in one place.
Your call history stays on this phone. OpenCaller never uploads it.
As your SMS app, OpenCaller sorts messages, filters spam and warns you about risky codes and links.
Your messages stay on this phone. OpenCaller never uploads them.
Show caller ID over other apps
This lets OpenCaller show a small caller card on top of your phone app during a call. Without it, caller ID appears as a notification.
The card appears only for calls. OpenCaller never reads what is on your screen.
